digest.component_or_area: store event append and ticket creation
propositions: Directory creation and first event write must be atomic to prevent empty stray ticket directories visible to fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH when the writer is interrupted between mkdir and first file write
Staging directory published via atomic os.rename under existing write lock, with dot-prefixed naming convention to exclude temp paths from scanner visibility without modifying fsck checks
Stale staging directories from dead processes are pruned at writer startup using process-stamp staleness adjudicator, bounded best-effort sweep touching only staging area not store data
All dir-then-file sites in store write path converted: batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT; exempt sites documented with reasons
Write lock discipline unchanged; event remains invisible to concurrency checks until rebase guard and under_lock_check pass after rename completes
Byte parity and committed layout preserved: canonical event serialization unchanged, only destination directory changes from direct publish to staged-then-renamed
